summary: Fixed a Flutter diagnostics lifecycle race when a selected screen-share track changes before the previous getReceiverStats request settles. Sampling is now scoped by generation, so stale results are ignored and an old request cannot retain or clear the active track's sampling lock. Local tests and Android/macOS/Windows build gates pass; live remote viewer acceptance remains open.

checks.name: Regression test before fix
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/screen_receiver_diagnostics_test.dart --plain-name 'a pending old track stats request cannot block a new track'
checks.observation: With the old implementation, switching tracks while the old stats Future was pending left the new track call count at 0 (expected 1).

checks.name: Focused receiver diagnostics widget suite
checks.observation: All six diagnostics widget/unit tests pass, including track switch while the old request is pending and protection against clearing the current request lock.
